properties.description: Reads `.reflow2.toml` beside a folder's `.reflow2/` ([design] id + address, optional [[also]]), refusing by name anything that is not a pointer; asks the server at the address which design it holds (design_identity) and classifies the answer as confirmed, different, refused or unconfirmed; builds the notice put in front of the handshake instructions and the refusal a degraded session reads. Seven unit tests.
properties.name: pointer.rs — a code folder's .reflow2.toml: read, checked against the server, and said to the agent
